race.comment: KING CARTEL (4) won nicely three back but hasn't featured in his past couple, racing over further last time out. Back to 1300m holds the key and he has enough speed to roll across from out wide. Can find the front and take plenty of catching. TOPAZ (13) bolted in here to win at this track and trip on Tuesday in an impressive performance. The inside barrier is a big tick for her chances and if she can handle the quick turnaround, she'll be hard to hold out. BORDER FORCE (6) was in good touch prior to tackling a stronger race over further last time where he got back and never threatened. Back to 1300m and dropping slightly in grade are both big ticks. Just needs to bounce back to his second-up effort. CABLE BOY (11) settled well back then came home powerfully to score by 0.6 lengths over 1435m at this track last time out. Rates highly and should go well again. GREAT EDITION (12) is not to be discounted.
